# Poseidon2 helper

`poseidon2.nr` is the unmodified `noir-lang/poseidon` v0.3.0 helper pinned by
pool-v1 §1: SHA-256
`44f3a3d1abe7d5fa2da5c0339e52018195d55f295c320e530d355f9cc62159d8`.
It uses the Noir standard library's Poseidon2 permutation.

The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in `LICENSE`; the repository's
CC0 dedication does not replace it. Its source and license match the copy
retained by the private-payment experiment.
